Quest: FetchWood04
DisplayName: Collect Wood for an Execution Scaffold
-- Message panels
QRC:

QuestorOffer:  [1000]
<ce> You look like you don't mind getting your hands dirty!
<ce> I have a spot of work, if you're interested?
<--->
<ce> How do you feel about doing some honest
<ce> salt-of-the-earth labor, %ra?
<ce> It pays well.
<--->
<ce> I'm in need of someone willing to do some
<ce> menial but well paid laboring!
<ce> Might you fit the bill?

RefuseQuest:  [1001]
<ce> That's the trouble with people these days.
<ce> Afraid of good old-fashioned hard work.
<--->
<ce> I should have known better than to ask a %ra!

AcceptQuest:  [1002]
<ce> We're running short of timber, don't you know.
<ce> And we have a very important Execution scheduled
<ce> so need the wood to build it in =deadline_ days!
<ce> Get us eight wood bundles before that day has
<ce> passed so we can get this thing built and the
<ce> criminal scum hanged.
<ce> I'll reward you with _reward_ gold if you do this.
<ce> I don't care how you get them, %pcn ...
<ce> just be sure you get them here in good time for
<ce> the Execution.
<--->
<ce> I really need to source a large amount of wood.
<ce> We have a very exciting Execution coming up,
<ce> you see. Need to start building in =deadline_ days.
<ce> I need you to get eight wood bundles at least,
<ce> to make sure that gallows is nice and high,
<ce> so everyone can see the villanous filth hang.
<ce> Get them to me before the deadline and
<ce> I'll pay you _reward_ gold.

QuestFail:  [1003]
<ce> You have failed to get _questgiver_
<ce> %g3 timber in time!

QuestComplete:  [1004]
<ce> Oh, good job, %pcn.
<ce> These eight wood bundles will make sure
<ce> that villan hangs on time!
<ce> Here's your _reward_ gold as promised.
<--->
<ce> My timber ... nicely chopped and everything!
<ce> Well done, %pcn. 
<ce> %oth, that scum will hang nice and high!
<ce> Here's your _reward_ gold.

QuestorPostsuccess:  [1008]
Hello %pcf. You did a fine job getting me that wood for execution scaffold. Now can I be of assistance?

QuestLogEntry:  [1010]
%qdt
_questgiver_ of __questgiver_ 
at ___questgiver_
has asked me to collect eight wood bundles
before =deadline_ days have passed.
I will be paid _reward_ gold for all eight of them.

Message:  1011
%qdt
_questgiver_ of __questgiver_ 
at ___questgiver_
paid me _reward_ gold for eight wood bundles.

Message:  1012
<ce> You don't have the eight wood bundles I asked for.
<ce> Come back when you have them all ...
<ce> and not before.
<--->
<ce> Stop waisting my time, %pcn!
<ce> Come back when you have the eight wood bundles.

Message:  1013
<ce> You have the eight wood bundles
<ce> that _questgiver_ of __questgiver_ 
<ce> at ___questgiver_ requires.


QBN:

Person _questgiver_ group Questor

Clock _deadline_ 96:00

Item _reward_ gold range 800 to 1000

--	Quest start-up:
	log 1010 step 0
	start timer _deadline_

variable _deadline_

_questgiverclicked_ task:
	clicked npc _questgiver_

_gotitem_ task:
	player possesses 8 items class 20 subclass 1604
	say 1013

_success_ task:
	when _questgiverclicked_ and _gotitem_
	player handsover 8 items class 20 subclass 1604
	give pc _reward_
    remove log step 0
	log 1011 step 1
	clear _questgiverclicked_
	end quest

_failure_ task:
	when _questgiverclicked_ and not _gotitem_
	say 1012
	clear _questgiverclicked_

_timeout_ task:
	when _deadline_ and not _success_
	say 1003
    remove log step 0
	end quest
